defects.summary: tools/command-center/reconcile_delivery.py::reconcile scores a unit as DELIVERED off ANOTHER unit's file. When the declared path is absent it falls back to a basename match (DELIVERED-ELSEWHERE-EXACT, :177-184) and then to a case/underscore-folded stem match (DELIVERED-ELSEWHERE-STEM, :186-193), and both feed delivered_any_form (:212-216). A worker that exits 0 and writes nothing is therefore recorded as delivered. Injected proof: the 'absent' mock scored DELIVERED-ELSEWHERE-EXACT on Windows and Linux alike. Live blast radius at HEAD: 28 of the 32 units in delivered_any_form (87.5%) have an ABSENT declared artifact and are matched to unrelated files, all 28 already flagged ambiguous=True; and 63 of 2007 catalogued units (3.14%) share a declared basename with another unit, so a sibling's file can satisfy them via the EXACT path too. The tool's own interpretation note discloses that a basename match is 'filename evidence, not verified content' but does NOT disclose that the matched file may belong to a different unit entirely.

Platform-dependent completion verdict. The same receipt over the same bytes yields opposite answers on Windows and Linux for four near-miss path forms, across four barriers (16 Windows-only accepts): completion_predicate.py:387 p.is_file(), receipt_schema_gate.py:304 (root / a['path']).is_file(), reconcile_delivery.py:107 path.is_file(), dispatch.py:305 p.read_bytes(). A receipt certified on a Windows box can fail in Linux CI and vice versa, and the artifact path a receipt records is not guaranteed to be the byte-exact name on disk. Note the receipt schema already bans backslashes in artifacts[].path (pattern ^[^\\]+$) but nothing bans a case-variant or a trailing space.

reconcile() holds two signals that can disagree and silently takes the permissive one. Its candidate index is built from git ls-files (byte-exact names from the git index) while _nonempty uses the OS path resolver. In the injected case_worker_upper run on Windows the git listing contained 'out/case1/Output.json' while _nonempty('out/case1/output.json') returned True, so the unit was scored DELIVERED-AT-DECLARED-PATH for a path that does not exist byte-exactly in the index. A self-contradicting detector is a detector failure, not a finding.

claims.py::complete_claim records COMPLETED for a receipt_path that does not exist and for an empty artifacts list. Disclosed by design (leak L-10) and guarded only by the convention that reducer.reduce_claim is subsequently run. Residual exposure: any consumer that reads claim state instead of a reduced verdict sees a completed unit that produced nothing. reduce_claim itself does fail closed on a missing receipt_path (reducer.py:263-268 raises StoreCorrupt), so the guard exists where it is used.

completion_predicate._c2_artifact_exists and receipt_schema_gate condition 2 both return SATISFIED for a 0-byte file at the declared path. Condition 3 (min_bytes_threshold) catches it in the same evaluation, so the composite predicate is sound; recorded because a caller reading condition 2 alone would be misled. Truncated-but-present artifacts are ADV-0004's target, not this unit's.

extensions.digest_basis: artifacts[0].sha256 is SHA-256 over this file's bytes with the 64-hex value at artifacts[0].sha256 replaced by 64 '0' characters (a file cannot contain its own digest). artifacts[0].bytes is the true on-disk size. See residual_unknowns[0] for the 3-line check.

reproduce.note: The Linux arm MUST use a native-filesystem tmp root (/tmp). Running it with a tmp root under /mnt/c reproduces the Windows answers, because DrvFs is case-insensitive.

extensions.not_a_duplicate_of_ADV_0004: ADV-0004 injects a PARTIAL artifact (present but truncated). This unit injects ABSENCE and NEAR-MISS PATHS. The 0-byte case (defect D5) is the only overlap and is recorded as INFO with the note that condition 3 already backstops it.
